purpose: 准备同版本、同模板和同依赖图的两份演示清单。
观察必填项已完成、可选前置项缺失时的 missing、blocked 和整体不就绪。
command: /usr/bin/python3 release_desk.py --store demo/releases.json audit-checklist 1.2.0 demo/missing.json demo/template.json --dependencies demo/dependencies.json
output: {"version": "1.2.0", "ready": false, "audit": {"version": "1.2.0", "ready": true, "done": [{"id": "release", "text": "Release approved", "required": true, "status": "done"}], "pending": [], "blocked": [], "missing": [{"id": "backup", "text": "Backup verified", "required": false, "status": "pending"}], "mismatched": [], "unexpected": []}, "dependencyCheck": {"version": "1.2.0", "ready": false, "items": [{"id": "release", "text": "Release approved", "required": true, "status": "done", "effectiveStatus": "blocked", "waiting": ["backup"]}, {"id": "backup", "text": "Backup verified", "required": false, "status": "pending", "effectiveStatus": "pending", "waiting": []}]}, "includedPrerequisites": ["backup"]}

purpose: 观察补齐已完成的前置项后，两个子报告及整体均就绪。
command: /usr/bin/python3 release_desk.py --store demo/releases.json audit-checklist 1.2.0 demo/complete.json demo/template.json --dependencies demo/dependencies.json
output: {"version": "1.2.0", "ready": true, "audit": {"version": "1.2.0", "ready": true, "done": [{"id": "release", "text": "Release approved", "required": true, "status": "done"}, {"id": "backup", "text": "Backup verified", "required": false, "status": "done"}], "pending": [], "blocked": [], "missing": [], "mismatched": [], "unexpected": []}, "dependencyCheck": {"version": "1.2.0", "ready": true, "items": [{"id": "release", "text": "Release approved", "required": true, "status": "done", "effectiveStatus": "done", "waiting": []}, {"id": "backup", "text": "Backup verified", "required": false, "status": "done", "effectiveStatus": "done", "waiting": []}]}, "includedPrerequisites": ["backup"]}
